messages:
emily: Hi all, first week. GH Actions on my fork passes but Buildkite jobs fail immediately with auth when I open a PR against infra/runner-sandbox. Anyone seen this?

tyler: welcome! Can you paste the Buildkite error + say if you're running the agent on k8s or a VM?

emily: error from pipeline webhook job: 
2026-03-28T10:02:11Z ERROR webhook: 403 Forbidden - installation not found for user/org
Also agent logs from k8s: 
ERR: buildkite-agent: failed to register: 401 Unauthorized - token invalid

tyler: two separate things possibly. The 403 for webhook usually means the GitHub App isn't authorized for that repo/org. If your org enforces SAML SSO (we do for some teams), GitHub Apps need to be approved for SSO. Check: GitHub -> Settings -> Applications -> Authorized integrations -> enable SSO for 'Redwood CI' for the org.

sam: and since you're on k8s the agent token lives in a k8s secret. If infra rotated tokens, the secret needs updating. Run (infra will do if you don't have k8s perms): `kubectl -n cicd get secret buildkite-agent -o yaml` then `kubectl create secret generic buildkite-agent --from-literal=token="<new-token>" -n cicd --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/buildkite-agent -n cicd`.

emily: i don't have kubectl access yet and i think the org SSO block is likely. I see the app in my personal account but not enabled for the org.

infra-bot: Notice: PR filed (CI-3207) to request SAML-authorized installation of 'Redwood CI' for repo infra/runner-sandbox by @sam.

tyler: @sam can you proxy the SSO approval? If the org requires an admin to approve the app for SAML, we'll need org-admins to toggle it.

sam: on it. I asked org-admins and enabled SSO for the app for infra/runner-sandbox. Also created a fresh agent token and updated the cicd secret. Restarting deployment now.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #412 queued: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/412

emily: thanks! any quick way i can verify the app has SSO enabled from my side?

tyler: in GitHub you should see the app under Organization -> Installed GitHub Apps -> Redwood CI and the config should say SAML: Authorized for infra. If you still see "installation not found" after that, re-trigger the webhook from pipeline settings.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #412 started and running jobs.

emily: jobs picked up and tests are running. :tada: thanks for the speedy help. Who should I ping if SSO or k8s secrets break later?

sam: ping #eng-infra and @infra-bot; if it's an SSO approval, also cc @org-admins. We'll add a short note to onboarding about k8s-agent secrets + SSO steps for forks.

emily: awesome, will do and I'll open a tiny docs PR with the checklist. :wave:
